observed_via_public_github_api.merge_group_workflow_run_id: Actions workflow run id for event=merge_group
observed_via_public_github_api.merge_group_head_sha: Synthetic merge-group commit tested by CI
observed_via_public_github_api.merge_group_created_updated_times: UTC timestamps on the workflow run
observed_via_public_github_api.pr_number_from_branch: Parsed from head_branch when regex matches
observed_via_public_github_api.queue_base_parent_sha: Parsed parent mainline oid embedded in queue branch
observed_via_public_github_api.check_runs_on_merge_group_head: Named checks with conclusions and durations
observed_via_public_github_api.check_runs_on_pr_head_at_fetch: Named checks on PR head at fetch time (not necessarily pre-queue)

partially_observable_or_delayed.multi_pr_batch_membership: Only inferred if branch name lists multiple pr-* segments; often single-PR branches
partially_observable_or_delayed.enqueue_position: MergeQueue GraphQL entries reflect live queue only
partially_observable_or_delayed.exact_pr_head_at_enqueue: Unless preserved in branch parent sha + PR metadata

unobservable_queue_internals.scheduler_batching_decision_log: Why PRs were or were not co-queued
unobservable_queue_internals.flake_retry_policy_parameters: Org/repo settings not in PR APIs

attribution_assay_eligibility.independent_comparison_available: Pair push/workflow CI on PR head vs merge_group CI on synthetic head for same normalized check names
attribution_assay_eligibility.ground_truth_culprit_pr: Not observable; assays use differential check outcomes only
